reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates pass. Gate 1: calc_interest has active non-test callers at market.move:1024 and market_query.move:68. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in scope; attack path depends on internal reserve state accumulation, not a trusted external source. Gate 3: interest.move is explicitly in scope and interest rate manipulation is a listed focus area. Code confirms the finding: reserve.move:65-72 computes util_rate = debt / (debt + cash - cash_reserve) with no cap, and interest.move:85-96 computes the rate in the high-kink branch without clamping, so util_rate > 1.0 yields borrow_rate > max_borrow_rate. Attack path requires ~1 year of sustained 95%+ utilization with no repayments, making exploitability plausible but time-dependent; severity Medium is maintained.
